data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: ai-guide
edge_embedded.summary: AI-Guide 是一个开源文档项目，旨在帮助开发者系统掌握 AI 技术应用。它通过结构化整理大模型选择指南、Prompt 工程、RAG 知识库等核心概念，将零散资源转化为可操作的学习路径。项目特别强调实践性，包含 AI 编程教程、开发框架指南和工具用法解析，让开发者能快速理解并应用如智能体技能、MCP 协议等前沿技术。你可以将其作为日常参考，根据具体需求查找实现方案，或跟随教程构建自己的 AI 应用原型。
edge_embedded.summary_en: AI-Guide is a comprehensive open-source documentation project that helps developers navigate the rapidly evolving AI landscape by providing curated resources and tutorials. It organizes practical knowledge around key AI concepts like prompt engineering, RAG systems, and AI development frameworks, making complex topics accessible through structured learning paths. Developers can use it as a reference hub to quickly find implementation guides, compare AI tools, and apply techniques like agent skills or MCP protocols in their own projects.

ui_devex.name: hello-agents
ui_devex.summary: Hello-agents是一个开源教程项目，旨在帮助开发者从零开始构建AI智能体，解决自主系统实现的复杂性。它通过实践指导，展示如何将大语言模型与工具、记忆模块结合，创建功能完整的智能体。项目采用循序渐进的教学方式，让学习者掌握智能体架构的核心设计。开发者可跟随教程构建定制化智能体，应用于数据分析、客服等场景，获得实际部署经验。
ui_devex.summary_en: Hello-agents is an open-source tutorial project that teaches developers how to build AI agents from scratch, addressing the complexity of implementing autonomous systems. It provides hands-on guidance on integrating large language models with tools and memory to create functional agents. Developers can follow its structured lessons to build custom agents for tasks like data analysis or customer support, gaining practical skills in agent architecture and deployment.

ui_devex.name: deer-flow
ui_devex.summary: Deer-Flow是一个开源智能体框架，旨在让AI系统自主完成研究、编程等耗时数分钟至数小时的复杂任务。其核心设计通过沙箱、记忆模块和工具集构建分层子智能体，使系统能并行处理子任务并协调结果，这种模块化架构提升了任务处理的灵活性与可靠性。开发者可将其应用于自动化代码生成、深度信息检索等场景，通过配置不同的技能组合来定制专属的工作流解决方案。
ui_devex.summary_en: Deer-Flow is an open-source agentic framework that enables AI systems to autonomously handle complex, multi-step tasks like research and coding. Its technical innovation lies in orchestrating specialized subagents with distinct tools and memories, allowing parallel execution of subtasks through a modular workflow. Developers can integrate it into applications requiring automated problem-solving, such as generating code from specifications or conducting web research, by configuring its agent hierarchy and toolset for specific domains.

ui_devex.name: learn-claude-code
ui_devex.summary: Learn-Claude-Code是一个教育性开源项目，展示如何从零构建类似Claude Code的轻量级AI智能体。它通过以Bash脚本为主要接口的最小化实现，教授智能体的核心概念，演示简单工具如何编排复杂AI工作流。该项目采用模块化架构，开发者可学习其设计模式，理解智能体如何分解任务、调用工具并管理状态。实践上，用户可基于此框架添加自定义工具，或将其集成到现有应用中，实现自动化代码辅助和任务处理，是学习智能体开发的实用起点。
ui_devex.summary_en: Learn-Claude-Code is an educational open-source project that demonstrates how to build a lightweight AI agent similar to Claude Code from scratch. It teaches core agent concepts through a minimal implementation using Bash scripting as the primary interface, showing how simple tools can orchestrate complex AI workflows. Developers can study its modular architecture to understand agent design patterns, then extend it with custom tools or integrate it into existing applications for automated coding assistance and task automation.

Developers can follow its structured lessons to build custom agents for tasks like data analysis or customer support, gaining practical skills in agent architecture and deployment.

summary_short.zh: Hello-agents是一个开源教程项目，旨在帮助开发者从零开始构建AI智能体，解决自主系统实现的复杂性。它通过实践指导，展示如何将大语言模型与工具、记忆模块结合，创建功能完整的智能体。项目采用循序渐进的教学方式，让学习者掌握智能体架构的核心设计。开发者可跟随教程构建定制化智能体，应用于数据分析、客服等场景，获得实际部署经验。

agents_workflows.name: deer-flow
agents_workflows.summary: Deer-Flow是一个开源智能体框架，旨在让AI系统自主完成研究、编程等耗时数分钟至数小时的复杂任务。其核心设计通过沙箱、记忆模块和工具集构建分层子智能体，使系统能并行处理子任务并协调结果，这种模块化架构提升了任务处理的灵活性与可靠性。开发者可将其应用于自动化代码生成、深度信息检索等场景，通过配置不同的技能组合来定制专属的工作流解决方案。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Deer-Flow is an open-source agentic framework that enables AI systems to autonomously handle complex, multi-step tasks like research and coding. Its technical innovation lies in orchestrating specialized subagents with distinct tools and memories, allowing parallel execution of subtasks through a modular workflow. Developers can integrate it into applications requiring automated problem-solving, such as generating code from specifications or conducting web research, by configuring its agent hierarchy and toolset for specific domains.

agents_workflows.name: learn-claude-code
agents_workflows.summary: Learn-Claude-Code是一个教育性开源项目，展示如何从零构建类似Claude Code的轻量级AI智能体。它通过以Bash脚本为主要接口的最小化实现，教授智能体的核心概念，演示简单工具如何编排复杂AI工作流。该项目采用模块化架构，开发者可学习其设计模式，理解智能体如何分解任务、调用工具并管理状态。实践上，用户可基于此框架添加自定义工具，或将其集成到现有应用中，实现自动化代码辅助和任务处理，是学习智能体开发的实用起点。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Learn-Claude-Code is an educational open-source project that demonstrates how to build a lightweight AI agent similar to Claude Code from scratch. It teaches core agent concepts through a minimal implementation using Bash scripting as the primary interface, showing how simple tools can orchestrate complex AI workflows. Developers can study its modular architecture to understand agent design patterns, then extend it with custom tools or integrate it into existing applications for automated coding assistance and task automation.

agents_workflows.name: ai-guide
agents_workflows.summary: AI-Guide 是一个开源文档项目，旨在帮助开发者系统掌握 AI 技术应用。它通过结构化整理大模型选择指南、Prompt 工程、RAG 知识库等核心概念，将零散资源转化为可操作的学习路径。项目特别强调实践性，包含 AI 编程教程、开发框架指南和工具用法解析，让开发者能快速理解并应用如智能体技能、MCP 协议等前沿技术。你可以将其作为日常参考，根据具体需求查找实现方案，或跟随教程构建自己的 AI 应用原型。
agents_workflows.summary_en: AI-Guide is a comprehensive open-source documentation project that helps developers navigate the rapidly evolving AI landscape by providing curated resources and tutorials. It organizes practical knowledge around key AI concepts like prompt engineering, RAG systems, and AI development frameworks, making complex topics accessible through structured learning paths. Developers can use it as a reference hub to quickly find implementation guides, compare AI tools, and apply techniques like agent skills or MCP protocols in their own projects.

agents_workflows.name: plano
agents_workflows.summary: Plano 是一个专为智能体应用设计的 AI 原生代理和数据平面，旨在简化部署流程并处理底层基础设施的复杂性。它通过充当智能网关，自动管理路由、负载均衡和监控任务，让开发者能专注于核心逻辑的开发，支持任意 AI 框架。在实际应用中，你可以将其集成到现有系统，以优化大语言模型推理、统一管理多个模型端点，并提升生产环境的可扩展性和可靠性，从而加速智能体应用的落地。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Plano is an AI-native proxy and data plane designed to simplify the deployment and management of agentic applications by handling infrastructure complexities. It works as a specialized gateway that offloads routing, load balancing, and monitoring tasks, allowing developers to focus on core agent logic using any AI framework. You can integrate it into your workflow to streamline LLM inference, manage multiple model endpoints, and enhance scalability for production-ready AI systems.

framework_core.name: Megatron-LM
framework_core.summary: Megatron-LM是一个开源框架，专门用于在数千个GPU上高效训练超大规模Transformer模型。其核心技术是张量并行，通过将单个模型层拆分到不同设备上来突破内存限制，同时保持计算效率。这种方法让研究人员能够训练最先进的语言模型，或借鉴其分布式优化思路改进自己的训练流程，为探索更大模型规模提供了实用方案。
framework_core.summary_en: Megatron-LM is an open-source framework for efficiently training massive transformer models by distributing them across thousands of GPUs. Its key innovation is tensor parallelism, which splits individual model layers across devices to overcome memory constraints while maintaining high computational efficiency. Researchers can use it to train state-of-the-art language models or adapt its techniques to optimize their own distributed training pipelines, making previously impossible model scales accessible.

framework_core.name: ai-guide
framework_core.summary: AI-Guide 是一个开源文档项目，旨在帮助开发者系统掌握 AI 技术应用。它通过结构化整理大模型选择指南、Prompt 工程、RAG 知识库等核心概念，将零散资源转化为可操作的学习路径。项目特别强调实践性，包含 AI 编程教程、开发框架指南和工具用法解析，让开发者能快速理解并应用如智能体技能、MCP 协议等前沿技术。你可以将其作为日常参考，根据具体需求查找实现方案，或跟随教程构建自己的 AI 应用原型。
framework_core.summary_en: AI-Guide is a comprehensive open-source documentation project that helps developers navigate the rapidly evolving AI landscape by providing curated resources and tutorials. It organizes practical knowledge around key AI concepts like prompt engineering, RAG systems, and AI development frameworks, making complex topics accessible through structured learning paths. Developers can use it as a reference hub to quickly find implementation guides, compare AI tools, and apply techniques like agent skills or MCP protocols in their own projects.

framework_core.name: plano
framework_core.summary: Plano 是一个专为智能体应用设计的 AI 原生代理和数据平面，旨在简化部署流程并处理底层基础设施的复杂性。它通过充当智能网关，自动管理路由、负载均衡和监控任务，让开发者能专注于核心逻辑的开发，支持任意 AI 框架。在实际应用中，你可以将其集成到现有系统，以优化大语言模型推理、统一管理多个模型端点，并提升生产环境的可扩展性和可靠性，从而加速智能体应用的落地。
framework_core.summary_en: Plano is an AI-native proxy and data plane designed to simplify the deployment and management of agentic applications by handling infrastructure complexities. It works as a specialized gateway that offloads routing, load balancing, and monitoring tasks, allowing developers to focus on core agent logic using any AI framework. You can integrate it into your workflow to streamline LLM inference, manage multiple model endpoints, and enhance scalability for production-ready AI systems.
